title: 2008 Calumet: the Hanford house, built from its 1883 drawing
items: 2008 Calumet Avenue is rebuilt from its rough draft. Read off the 1911 fire-insurance map and the architects' 1883 drawing, it is now a brownstone house of two storeys over a raised basement under a steep slate roof with gabled dormers. A corner pavilion rises to a tall pointed roof with an iron finial, a columned porch with a balcony stands over the front steps, and two tall stone chimneys rise from the south side.
